metadata.description: InfoPros OS tools for the InfoPros team's own assistants.

plugins.name: infopros-os
plugins.description: InfoPros OS for the InfoPros team. Ask about client data in plain words and get short answers with links: webinar numbers and recaps, WebinarJam attendance, Meta ad numbers, who changed what in the ads, winning creatives, booked calls and cash, launches, and what was said in Slack, on calls or in the SOPs. Commands: /recap, /morning, /why, /client, /winners and /results-form. Also edits talking-head videos into short-form reels or long-form 16:9 page videos, finds highlights in long videos, transcribes, and edits on your own computer when a video can't go up.
